scope: Bounded primary-source inspection for a neutral working paper. Bibliographic identity and the specified passages were inspected; no external result was reproduced or independently certified. Existing v11/v12 artifacts are preserved.
hash_policy: source_receipts.py separately acquires bounded HTML/plain-code bytes and records time/hash without storing full copyrighted text. The hash identifies that HTTP response, not a PDF, an abstract's truth, or the browser-rendered passage. Failed retrieval is null; browser inspection and byte acquisition are separate observations.
